summary: Jefferies Financial Group filed a Rule 424(b)(5) pricing supplement for $3,268,000 of Senior Autocallable Contingent Coupon Barrier Notes due September 30, 2032, issued under its Series A Global Medium-Term Notes program. The notes are senior unsecured obligations linked to the worst-performing of the VanEck Semiconductor ETF (SMH) and the S&P 500 Index, priced at $1,000 per note with a $35 quarterly contingent coupon, quarterly call observation beginning March 29, 2027, and full principal loss below the threshold. This is an ordinary shelf takedown of structured notes, not a special situation; no deal terms apply.
